menu.unbuilt.noOnline: There is no online documentation, feedback or update service set up for OpenMind Studio yet.
menu.unbuilt.devTools: Developer tools and the process explorer aren't available in this build.
menu.unbuilt.defaultBuild: Mark the build task in tasks.json with "group": {"kind": "build", "isDefault": true} (Configure Tasks... opens it).
menu.unbuilt.workspaces: Multi-folder workspace files aren't built yet: OpenMind opens one folder per window.
menu.unbuilt.productIcons: Product icon themes aren't built: there is one built-in set of interface icons.
menu.unbuilt.onlineServices: There are no online services to configure.
menu.unbuilt.snippets: User snippet files aren't built yet (extensions can contribute snippets).
menu.unbuilt.breakpointKinds: Line breakpoints (with conditions, hit counts and logpoints) are supported; function, inline and triggered breakpoints aren't yet.
menu.unbuilt.editorLayout: Editor groups are side by side only for now: use Single, Two Columns, Three Columns or Split Right.
menu.unbuilt.usedEditors: Switching by most recently used isn't built yet: use Next Editor / Previous Editor.
menu.unbuilt.replaceInFiles: Replace in Files isn't built yet. Find in Files and the editor's Replace work.
menu.unbuilt.emmet: Emmet isn't built in. An extension can provide it.
menu.unbuilt.openView: Open a view from the activity bar or the View menu.
view.remoteExplorerReason: Remote Explorer isn't available yet — remote connections aren't supported.

setting.editor.fontSize.title: Font Size
setting.editor.fontSize.description: Font size of the editor in pixels.
setting.editor.fontFamily.title: Font Family
setting.editor.fontFamily.description: Font family list of the editor, most preferred first.
setting.editor.tabSize.title: Tab Size
setting.editor.tabSize.description: Number of spaces a tab is equal to.
setting.editor.insertSpaces.title: Insert Spaces
setting.editor.lineNumbers.title: Line Numbers
setting.editor.lineNumbers.description: Controls how line numbers are shown.
setting.editor.cursorBlinking.title: Cursor Blinking
setting.editor.cursorBlinking.descriptio: Animation style of the editor cursor.
setting.editor.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap
setting.editor.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines at the edge of the editor.
setting.editor.minimap.title: Minimap
setting.editor.minimap.description: Show the minimap on the right of the editor.
setting.editor.stickyScroll.title: Sticky Scroll
setting.editor.stickyScroll.description: Keep the enclosing scopes visible at the top while scrolling.
setting.editor.renderWhitespace.title: Render Whitespace
setting.editor.renderWhitespace.descript: Show spaces and tabs as dots and arrows.
setting.files.autoSave.title: Auto Save
setting.files.autoSave.description: Save changed files by themselves: after a short delay, when you switch to another editor, or when you leave the window. An unsaved new file is never saved automatically.
setting.files.autoSaveDelay.title: Auto Save Delay
setting.files.autoSaveDelay.description: Milliseconds after the last edit before Auto Save (After Delay) saves the file.
setting.editor.formatOnSave.title: Format on Save
setting.editor.formatOnSave.description: Format a text file with its formatter just before it is saved. If there is no formatter or it fails, the file is still saved as it is.
setting.editor.defaultFormatter.title: Default Formatter
setting.editor.defaultFormatter.descript: The id of the formatter to prefer (for example prettier, biome, black, ruff, builtin.json). It is used for the languages it supports; other languages ignore it. Format Document With... can set a per-language choice.
setting.formatter.timeoutMs.title: Formatter Time Limit
setting.formatter.timeoutMs.description: An external formatter that takes longer than this many milliseconds is stopped and the text is left as it is.
setting.formatter.useProjectLocalTools.d: Run a formatter installed in the open project (node_modules/.bin, .venv, vendor/bin). Project tools are programs from the folder you opened: turn this off for folders you do not trust.
setting.formatter.useBundledTools.title: Formatters: Use Bundled Tools
setting.formatter.useBundledTools.descri: Run a formatter from OpenMind's own tools folder.
setting.formatter.useSystemTools.title: Formatters: Use System Tools
setting.formatter.useSystemTools.descrip: Also run a formatter found on the computer's PATH when nothing else provides one.
setting.search.caseSensitive.title: Match Case
setting.search.caseSensitive.description: Search is case sensitive by default.
setting.search.useRegex.title: Use Regular Expression
setting.search.useRegex.description: Search queries are regular expressions by default.
setting.search.wholeWord.title: Match Whole Word
setting.search.wholeWord.description: Search matches whole words only by default.
setting.search.include.title: Files to Include
setting.search.include.description: Default glob patterns of the search's include field, separated by commas.
setting.search.exclude.title: Files to Exclude
setting.search.exclude.description: Default glob patterns of the search's exclude field, separated by commas.
setting.search.indexing.enabled.title: Index the Workspace
setting.search.indexing.enabled.descript: Index the open folder in the background so file, text and symbol search are fast. The index stays on this machine, in the app's own folder, and may contain your project's text.
setting.search.indexing.exclude.title: Index: Files to Exclude
setting.search.indexing.exclude.descript: Glob patterns of files and folders the index never reads, separated by commas (node_modules, .git, target, dist and build are always skipped).
setting.search.indexing.maxFileSizeKb.de: Files larger than this many kilobytes are listed by name but their text is not indexed.
setting.search.indexing.useGitignore.des: Leave out files that .gitignore files exclude. (.openmindignore files are always honoured.)
setting.search.indexing.indexHiddenFiles: Index files and folders whose names start with a dot.
setting.ai.enabled.title: Enable AI Features
setting.ai.enabled.description: Show the AI panel and AI commands while at least one AI provider is enabled. Turn it off to hide all AI features (providers and history are kept).
setting.ai.defaultProvider.title: Default Provider
setting.ai.defaultProvider.description: Id of the provider the AI panel selects first. It is set from the AI provider manager.
setting.ai.defaultModel.title: Default Model
setting.ai.defaultModel.description: The model used first when the default provider has none chosen. It is set from the AI provider manager.
setting.ai.confirmBeforeOnlineRequest.de: Ask before any text leaves this computer for an online AI provider, naming the provider and what is sent. Requests to a server on this computer are never asked about.
setting.ai.saveConversationHistory.title: Save Conversation History
setting.ai.saveConversationHistory.descr: Keep AI conversations on this computer (in the app's own folder) so they are there after a restart. When off, a chat lasts until you close it.
setting.terminal.fontSize.title: Font Size
setting.terminal.fontSize.description: Font size of the integrated terminal in pixels.
setting.terminal.fontFamily.title: Font Family
setting.terminal.fontFamily.description: Font family list of the integrated terminal.
setting.terminal.cursorBlink.title: Cursor Blink
setting.terminal.scrollback.title: Scrollback
setting.terminal.scrollback.description: Number of lines a terminal keeps.
setting.run.saveBeforeRun.title: Save Before Run
setting.run.saveBeforeRun.description: Save the file before Run Code runs it. When off, a file with unsaved changes can't be run.
setting.run.clearOutputBeforeRun.title: Clear Output Before Run
setting.run.clearOutputBeforeRun.descrip: Clear the language's Output channel each time Run Code starts.
setting.git.autoRefresh.title: Auto Refresh
setting.git.autoRefresh.description: Refresh Source Control when the window gets focus and when files change.
setting.git.showBranchInStatusBar.title: Show Branch in Status Bar
setting.git.showBranchInStatusBar.descri: Show the current branch in the status bar.
setting.lsp.enabled.title: Enable Language Servers
setting.lsp.enabled.description: Start language servers for files in the open folder. Turning it off stops the running ones.
setting.lsp.verboseLogging.title: Verbose Logging
setting.lsp.verboseLogging.description: Write every message exchanged with a language server to the LSP output channel.
setting.debug.stopOnEntry.title: Stop on Entry
setting.debug.stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the first line when a debug session starts.
setting.debug.openConsoleOnStart.title: Open Debug Console on Start
setting.debug.openConsoleOnStart.descrip: Show the Debug Console panel when a debug session starts (off: the panel opens only when you open it).
setting.extensions.allowSystemNode.title: Allow System Node.js for Extensions
setting.extensions.allowSystemNode.descr: Run the extension host with a Node.js found on this computer when OpenMind's portable Node.js is not installed. It is always labelled as the system Node.js.
setting.extensions.marketplace.autoFetch: Load the Popular list from Open VSX (open-vsx.org) whenever the Extensions view is shown (not at launch). Turn it off to contact the marketplace only when you search, load Popular, open an extension page or install.
setting.php.server.defaultPort.title: Default Port
setting.php.server.defaultPort.descripti: Port the PHP server uses until you choose another one in the PHP control panel.
setting.php.tray.hideOnClose.title: Keep Servers Running in the Tray
setting.php.tray.hideOnClose.description: Closing the main window while a PHP, MariaDB or phpMyAdmin server runs hides the app to the system tray instead of quitting.
setting.network.proxy.mode.title: Proxy
setting.network.proxy.mode.description: How programs OpenMind starts (terminals, Run Code, tasks, Git, package managers, downloads) reach the network. No Proxy changes nothing. Use System Proxy uses the proxy Windows or the environment already names. Manual Proxy uses the addresses below. Only processes OpenMind starts are affected; Windows' own settings are never changed.
setting.network.proxy.http.title: HTTP Proxy
setting.network.proxy.http.description: Manual proxy for http:// addresses, as host:port or http://host:port. Put the user name and password in Network: Proxy Settings, not here.
setting.network.proxy.https.title: HTTPS Proxy
setting.network.proxy.https.description: Manual proxy for https:// addresses. Empty: the HTTP proxy is used for https:// too.
setting.network.proxy.socks.title: SOCKS Proxy
setting.network.proxy.socks.description: Optional SOCKS5 proxy (socks5://host:port), passed as ALL_PROXY. Not every tool supports SOCKS.
setting.network.proxy.noProxy.title: No Proxy For
setting.network.proxy.noProxy.descriptio: Comma-separated hosts that are reached directly (for example intranet.local, .corp). localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 are always direct.
setting.network.goProxy.title: Go Module Proxy
setting.network.goProxy.description: GOPROXY for Go commands OpenMind starts. Empty: Go's own setting is used.
setting.network.testUrl.title: Connection Test Address
setting.network.testUrl.description: The address Test Connection requests (http or https). Nothing is contacted until you press Test.
setting.network.offline.useWheelhouse.de: Let pip in processes OpenMind starts also look in the imported offline wheels (PIP_FIND_LINKS). pip's own configuration is not changed.
setting.workbench.colorTheme.title: Color Theme
setting.workbench.colorTheme.description: Colors of the workbench, the editor and the terminal. System follows Windows.
setting.workbench.iconTheme.title: Icon Theme
setting.workbench.iconTheme.description: The icons in the Explorer, tabs and search. The built-in themes are bundled with the app; an extension's icon theme uses the images inside that extension. Nothing is downloaded.
setting.workbench.iconTheme.option.minim: Minimal (one file icon, no folder icons)
setting.workbench.language.title: Display Language
setting.workbench.language.description: The language of OpenMind Studio's own menus, dialogs and messages. System Default follows the language of Windows; English is used for anything a language doesn't translate. Code, file paths and extensions keep their own text.
setting.workbench.welcomeOnStartup.title: Show Welcome Page on Startup
setting.workbench.welcomeOnStartup.descr: Open the Welcome page when the app starts.
settings.language.appliesNow: The language changes at once. Monaco's own editor widgets (find box, command palette) stay in English.
settings.row.resetUserTitle: Remove this setting from the user settings file (default: {value})
settings.row.resetWorkspaceTitle: Remove this setting from the workspace settings file (default: {value})
settings.row.overridden: The open folder overrides this in its workspace settings, so that value is the one in force here.
settings.tab.userFileProblem: The user settings file has a problem, so its values are ignored and it will not be changed: {error}
settings.tab.workspaceFileProblem: The workspace settings file has a problem, so its values are ignored and it will not be changed: {error}
keys.searchPlaceholder: Search by command name, category or keybinding
keys.fileProblem: keybindings.json has a problem, so the defaults are used and it will not be changed: {error}
databaseError.heading: OpenMind Studio couldn't start
databaseError.unreadable: OpenMind Studio couldn't open its local database, and the details couldn't be read either: {error}
databaseError.backUpExplained: This moves the database files into a new backup folder inside {folder} and starts OpenMind Studio with a new, empty database. Recent files, sessions, window sizes, saved AI keys and the MariaDB password stay in the backup. Your projects, settings files, runtimes and extensions are not touched. Nothing is deleted.
databaseError.moved: The database was moved to {folder}. Nothing was deleted.
databaseError.kind.checksumMismatch.titl: The local database doesn't match this build
databaseError.kind.checksumMismatch.expl: OpenMind Studio could not open the local database because migration {version}'s checksum does not match this build. This can happen if a previous development build used different SQL file line endings or a different version of that migration. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.unknownMigration.titl: The local database was made by a newer OpenMind Studio
databaseError.kind.unknownMigration.expl: The database has an update (migration {version}) that this version doesn't know, so it was probably created or updated by a newer OpenMind Studio. This version won't change it. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.partialMigration.titl: An earlier database update didn't finish
databaseError.kind.partialMigration.expl: Migration {version} was started earlier and never finished (the app may have been stopped while it ran). OpenMind Studio won't guess how to complete it. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.migrationFailed.title: The local database couldn't be updated
databaseError.kind.migrationFailed.expla: Updating the database to this version (migration {version}) failed. Your data was not deleted.
Updating the database to this version failed. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.locked.title: The local database is in use
databaseError.kind.locked.explanation: Another program holds the database — often another OpenMind Studio started from this same folder. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.corrupt.title: The local database file is damaged
databaseError.kind.corrupt.explanation: The database file is damaged or isn't a SQLite database. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.readOnly.title: The local database can't be opened or written
databaseError.kind.readOnly.explanation: OpenMind Studio needs to read and write its data folder, which is next to the program. The folder may be read-only, on a disconnected drive, or blocked by permissions. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.diskFull.title: The disk is full
databaseError.kind.diskFull.explanation: The database couldn't be written because the disk is full. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.kind.other.title: The local database couldn't be opened
databaseError.kind.other.explanation: OpenMind Studio couldn't open its local database. Your data was not deleted.
databaseError.step.exitAndUse: Exit, and start the OpenMind Studio build that last used this folder.
databaseError.step.backUp: Back Up and Start Fresh moves the database into a backup folder and starts with a new one (recent files, sessions and saved keys stay in the backup).
databaseError.step.useNewer: Exit, and use the newer version of OpenMind Studio.
databaseError.step.reportKept: Copy Error Details and report it with the database kept.
databaseError.step.closeOther: Close the other copy of OpenMind Studio, then start it again.
databaseError.step.restoreBackup: Restore the file from a backup of this folder if you have one.
databaseError.step.checkWritable: Check that the folder is writable (not a read-only drive or a protected location such as Program Files), then start again.
databaseError.step.freeSpace: Free some space on this drive, then start again.
databaseError.step.report: Copy Error Details and report it.

php.netstat.asOf: Listening TCP ports as of {time}. Rows from OpenMind's own servers are marked.
php.netstat.note: Listening TCP ports. Rows from OpenMind's own servers are marked.
php.help.startStop: Start / Stop starts or stops that module. Nothing starts by itself.
php.help.webRoot: The PHP server is not tied to one project: it serves the web root (the app's htdocs folder unless you choose another), and every folder inside it is its own site at http://127.0.0.1:8000/<folder>/. The root page lists them.
php.help.admin: Admin opens the module in your browser (MariaDB is managed through phpMyAdmin).
php.help.config: Config in a row opens that module's config file in Notepad. The Config button on the right opens the web root, ports, PHP versions, Composer (with its own project folder) and the MariaDB password.
php.help.logs: Logs shows only that module's lines in the log below; click again for all.
php.help.netstat: Netstat lists the TCP ports that are listening on this computer, with their process. Shell opens a console with the portable PHP, Composer, Python, Node and Git first on PATH, in the web root. Explorer opens the web root.
php.help.quit: Quit closes this window; the servers keep running. Closing the main OpenMind Studio window while a server runs hides the app in the system tray (servers keep running). The tray icon brings it back, has Stop All Servers, and Quit OpenMind Studio stops everything.
php.help.local: Everything listens on 127.0.0.1 only. No Windows service, admin rights or PATH change.

welcome.card.runtimesText: Install Node.js, Python, Git and PHP into the app folder — no admin rights, no PATH changes.
welcome.card.phpText: Run PHP, MariaDB and phpMyAdmin XAMPP-style; every folder in htdocs is a site.
welcome.card.languageText: Language servers for code completion, errors and go to definition.
welcome.card.keysText: See every shortcut, change it, and find conflicts.
welcome.card.settingsText: Editor, terminal, Git, debugger and theme settings, for you or for one folder.

profiles.lead: A profile is a set of settings you can switch between. It covers appearance (theme, icon theme), the editor (font, tabs, minimap ...), formatting and Auto Save, search indexing, the AI switch and marketplace auto-load. Keyboard shortcuts, extensions and runtimes are shared by all profiles. Profiles stay on this computer.

network.title: Network
network.lead: The proxy applies only to programs OpenMind starts (terminals, Run Code, tasks, Git, package managers, runtime and extension downloads). Windows' proxy, PATH and the tools' own configuration are never changed.
network.policy: OpenMind uses only the proxy you set or the one Windows already uses. It does not bypass firewalls, captive portals or network rules, and it contacts nothing until you press Test or start a download.
network.pacNotSupported: Windows uses an automatic configuration script ({url}). OpenMind can't evaluate it: choose Manual Proxy and enter the proxy address your network gives you.
network.source.noneDetected: No proxy detected: connections go directly.
network.problem.dns: the server's name could not be found (DNS)
network.problem.proxyUnavailable: the proxy is unavailable or the address is wrong
network.problem.proxyAuthRequired: the proxy requires a user name and password
network.problem.tls: the secure connection (TLS certificate) was refused
network.problem.blocked: the network or server blocked the address
network.problem.notFound: the file was not found on the server
network.problem.http: the server answered with an error
network.problem.checksum: the file did not match its checksum
network.problem.insecureUrl: only http:// and https:// addresses are allowed
network.invalid.scheme: Use http://, https:// (or socks5:// for the SOCKS proxy).
network.invalid.credentials: Don't put a user name or password in the address; use the credentials fields below.
network.invalid.port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
network.credentials.title: Proxy Authentication
network.credentials.lead: Only if your proxy asks for them. They are encrypted by Windows for your user account, never shown again and never written to logs.
network.test.title: Test Connection
network.test.lead: Sends one request to the address below, now, through the proxy in force. Leave it empty to use the Connection Test Address setting.
network.env.none: No proxy variables: new terminals start with the environment they always had.
network.terminal.applied: Proxy environment applied to this terminal session.
network.failure.title: {source}: {problem}.
network.offline.lead: Bring packages on a USB drive or from another computer: runtime archives listed by the Runtime Manager, extensions (.vsix), Python wheels (.whl), npm packages (.tgz), Composer packages and source ZIPs. Each file is checked (type, architecture, SHA-256) and copied into the app's own cache; global package caches are never touched.
network.offline.importedRuntime: Imported {name} {version}. Install it from the Runtime Manager: no download is needed.
network.offline.importedWheel: Imported {name}. With "Use Offline Python Packages" on, pip in new terminals also looks here.
network.offline.importedVsix: Imported {name}. Confirm the installation in the Extensions view.
network.offline.importedSource: Imported {name}. Use Extract to Folder to unpack it into an empty folder.
workloads.firstRun.title: Choose what to install
workloads.welcome.lead: OpenMind Studio works without any of this. Choose the languages and tools you want, or skip and install them later from Runtime Manager > Workloads.
workloads.welcome.policy: Everything installs inside the app's own folder, without administrator rights. PATH, the Registry and your tools' global settings are never changed, and nothing downloads until you press Install.
workloads.location.lead: Runtimes and SDKs are installed here, next to OpenMind Studio:
workloads.location.policy: Move or copy the app folder and they move with it. Tools' caches (Go modules, Gradle, NuGet, pub) are kept in the app's cache folder too.
workloads.runtimes.title: Runtimes, SDKs and tools
workloads.network.lead: Downloads use the proxy set in Network: Proxy Settings (Milestone 21). On a network that needs a proxy, set it before installing.
workloads.offline.lead: No network? Import runtime archives, SDK archives, extensions and wheels from a USB drive: a runtime archive the Runtime Manager knows installs without downloading.
workloads.summaryPage.nothing: Nothing will be downloaded: everything selected is already installed, or is installed outside OpenMind.
workloads.summary.title: Summary
workloads.card.licenseNeeded: Its vendor licence must be accepted before it is installed.
workloads.card.logs: Install progress and errors are written to the Runtime Manager output channel.

workloads.license.title: Accept licences
workloads.license.lead: These downloads come with their vendor's terms. Read them; OpenMind installs them only if you accept. Accepting here never accepts licences inside a tool (for example sdkmanager asks again).

workload.minimal.name: Minimal install
workload.minimal.summary: OpenMind Studio only: no optional downloads. Install anything later from Runtime Manager > Workloads.
workload.web.name: Web development
workload.web.summary: Node.js, package managers, TypeScript, the web language servers, linters, formatters and front-end frameworks.
workload.python.name: Python development
workload.python.summary: Python with pip and venv, the debugger, Pyright, Ruff, Black, pytest, notebooks and offline wheels.
workload.php.name: PHP / Laravel
workload.php.summary: PHP, Composer, MariaDB and phpMyAdmin, Laravel tools and the PHP language server.
workload.dotnet.name: .NET / C# development
workload.dotnet.summary: The .NET 10 SDK with its runtimes and templates. Visual Studio Build Tools, .NET Framework and MAUI stay external.
workload.java.name: Java / Kotlin development
workload.java.summary: Temurin JDK 21, Maven, Gradle and the Kotlin compiler.
workload.mobile.name: Flutter / Dart / mobile
workload.mobile.summary: Flutter and Dart, the Android command-line and platform tools with the JDK and Gradle, and React Native / Expo / Ionic / Capacitor helpers. Android Studio and the emulator stay external.
workload.systems.name: Systems development
workload.systems.summary: Go, a C/C++ toolchain (LLVM-MinGW with LLDB), CMake, Ninja, clangd and rust-analyzer. Rust itself installs with rustup.
workload.database.name: Database development
workload.database.summary: MariaDB with its client, PostgreSQL client tools, SQLite tools and phpMyAdmin.
workload.devops.name: DevOps / cloud tools
workload.devops.summary: Git and Git LFS, kubectl, Helm, Terraform and the YAML/Dockerfile/Bash language servers. Docker stays external.
workload.aiml.name: AI / ML development
workload.aiml.summary: Python with notebooks and offline wheels, ONNX Runtime in projects and local model providers. GPU drivers stay external.
workload.full-offline.name: Full offline toolkit
workload.full-offline.summary: Every runtime and SDK OpenMind can install, the offline language servers, the debuggers and the offline cache. Several GB: deselect the heavy SDKs you don't need.

workloadComponent.dotnet-templates.note: dotnet new (console, web, blazor, classlib ...) comes with the SDK.
workloadComponent.mysql-client.note: The mariadb client (MySQL-compatible) comes with MariaDB.
workloadComponent.dart-analysis-server.n: Comes with the Dart SDK (dart language-server). OpenMind doesn't start it as a language server yet.
workloadComponent.lsp-intelephense.note: Its licence doesn't allow bundling: installed from npm when you click Install in Language Tools.
workloadComponent.browser-preview.note: File previews and the PHP server.
workloadComponent.notebooks.note: Opens .ipynb files; runs cells with a Python kernel.
workloadComponent.laravel-helper.note: Copies DB settings and shows Laravel commands.
workloadComponent.local-ai.note: Talks to a model server you run (Ollama, LM Studio ...).
workloadComponent.docker.note: A system service with admin rights: install Docker Desktop yourself. OpenMind detects the docker CLI.
workloadComponent.msvc.note: Needs the Visual Studio installer and admin rights. OpenMind never installs it; LLVM-MinGW covers MinGW builds.
workloadComponent.dotnet-framework.note: A Windows system component (4.8 ships with Windows). Not the modern .NET SDK; OpenMind only detects it.
workloadComponent.maui.note: Needs `dotnet workload install maui` plus the Android/iOS SDKs; OpenMind doesn't install it.
workloadComponent.android-studio.note: A large IDE installer; OpenMind never installs it silently.
workloadComponent.android-emulator.note: Heavy (system images, hardware acceleration); install it with sdkmanager or Android Studio yourself.
workloadComponent.xcode.note: iOS and macOS builds need Xcode on a Mac.
workloadComponent.rustup.note: Installed with rustup into your user profile; OpenMind detects cargo and rustc.
workloadComponent.redis.note: Redis publishes no official Windows build: use WSL or Docker.
workloadComponent.cuda.note: A driver-level stack installed by NVIDIA's installer. OpenMind never installs GPU drivers.
workloadComponent.rocm.note: A driver-level stack; not available for Windows desktops in general. Never installed by OpenMind.
workloadComponent.gdb.note: Not packaged: use LLDB from LLVM-MinGW.
workloadComponent.jdtls.note: OpenMind can't start JDT LS yet.
workloadComponent.csharp-lsp.note: OpenMind can't start a C# language server yet.
workloadComponent.phpactor.note: A future offline (MIT) option for PHP.
workloadComponent.nuget-offline.note: Importing .nupkg files into the offline cache is not supported yet.
network.problem.unreachable: the network has no route to the address
network.hint.tlsHandshake: The secure connection couldn't be set up: the server may not speak HTTPS on this port, or the network interrupts HTTPS.
network.label.blocked: Blocked by the network or server
network.hint.dns: This computer couldn't resolve the name. Check the address; on a network that reaches the internet only through a proxy, set the proxy above.
network.hint.tls: The server's certificate wasn't trusted. A network that inspects HTTPS needs its own certificate installed in Windows; ask the network's administrator.
network.hint.proxyAuthRequired: Save the proxy user name and password below, then test again.
network.hint.proxyUnavailable: Check the proxy's address and port, and that the proxy is running.
network.hint.timeout: Nothing answered in time. The server, the proxy or the network may be slow or blocking the address.
network.hint.connectionFailed: Nothing accepted the connection at that address and port.
network.hint.unreachable: This computer has no route to the address: no network, or the network doesn't let it through.
network.hint.blocked: The network or the server refused this address. Ask the network's administrator if it should be allowed.
network.diag.title: Diagnostics
network.diag.ignored.credentialsInAddres: {field} proxy is ignored because it contains credentials in the URL. Store credentials in the secure username/password fields instead.
network.diag.ignored.unsupportedScheme: {field} proxy is ignored because its scheme isn't supported. Use http://, https:// or socks5://.
network.diag.ignored.badPort: {field} proxy is ignored because its port isn't valid (1-65535).
network.diag.ignored.invalidAddress: {field} proxy is ignored because it isn't a valid host:port address.
network.diag.ignored.empty: {field} proxy is ignored because it is empty.
network.diag.pacNotEvaluated: Windows uses a proxy auto-configuration script ({url}). OpenMind doesn't run PAC scripts: if downloads fail, set the proxy manually.
network.diag.autoDetectNotEvaluated: Windows is set to detect the proxy automatically (WPAD). OpenMind doesn't do that lookup: if downloads fail, set the proxy manually.
network.diag.socksOnly: Only a SOCKS proxy is set. pip, npm, pnpm, Yarn and Cargo read HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and won't use it; set an HTTP proxy for them if the network has one.
network.diag.noCredentials: No proxy user name and password are saved. That's fine unless the proxy asks for them (error 407).
network.diag.credentialsUnreadable: The saved proxy credentials can't be read (saved by another Windows user, or damaged). Save them again.
network.diag.staleTerminals: Some open terminals still use the old proxy settings. Open a new terminal to apply them.
network.failure.pipProxyAuth: pip could not reach PyPI because the network proxy requires authentication. This is not a missing Python package.
network.failure.pipNetwork: pip could not reach PyPI ({problem}). This is not a missing Python package.
network.failure.pipNotMissing: This looks like a proxy authentication problem, not a missing Python package. Save the proxy user name and password, then Retry Command.
network.failure.authHint: Save the proxy user name and password in Configure Proxy, then retry.
network.stale.banner: Proxy settings changed. Open a new terminal to apply them.
network.stale.confirmNote: The shell and everything running in it are closed; a new terminal opens with the same shell and folder and the current proxy settings.
network.stale.failed: A new terminal couldn't be started; the current one was kept.
network.retry.confirmNote: This command can delete or change files or system settings, so it runs again only if you confirm. It runs in a new terminal with the current proxy settings.
network.wheels.title: Python wheelhouse
network.wheels.lead: pip installs from the imported wheels only (--no-index): nothing is downloaded, and a folder with spaces in its path works.
network.wheels.refused: Not imported (not for this computer, or not a wheel):
network.wheels.none: No wheels imported yet. Use Import Wheels Folder with a folder from a USB drive or another computer.
network.wheels.started: pip install from the wheelhouse was typed into a new terminal (no network request).
network.wheels.noShell: No terminal shell can take this command (WSL can't); open PowerShell, Command Prompt or Git Bash.
